global.label: Quick Start
global.body:
Welcome to **TrustGraph**!

1. Upload a document in **Document Ingestion**
2. Explore the graph in **Context Graph Explorer**
3. Ask questions with **Graph RAG Query**

For step-by-step tutorials, see the [guides](https://docs.trustgraph.ai/guides/).

global.label: Give Feedback
global.body:
We'd love to hear from you!

- Join the conversation on [Discord](https://discord.gg/trustgraph)
